name: kynvera-brand-compliance
description: UI brand rules enforcement using brand-guide.md, design-tokens.json, logos, typography, color, spacing, iconography, and motion.

# Purpose
Use this skill for visual, UI, redesign, and layout changes to keep work aligned with the Kynvera brand identity.

# Rules
- Read brand-guide.md and design-tokens.json before performing visual work.
- Enforce the Kynvera palette, Manrope/JetBrains Mono typography pairing, and cyan as a measured signal.
- Use SVG-first logos, sharp technical surfaces, subtle animation, and correct clear space.
- Do not introduce visually trendy effects that conflict with the brand.

# Workflow
1. Read `brand-guide.md` and `design-tokens.json`.
2. Identify target UI elements (buttons, cards, heroes, or surfaces).
3. Apply tokens for typography, spacing, color, and motion.
4. Check layout across both dark and light theme states.
